_why: A page whose title says "vs" is a comparison, and a comparison is read as a table. Google and the answer engines lift a list or table snippet from a literal <table>, never from prose; the owner's Search Readiness Checklist (item d2, 25 Oct 2026) audits this site for it every Monday and reported /answers/party-decor-vs-event-planning-memphis on 2026-10-26. Five published comparison pages carried none. This file is the ONE source for all of them, keyed by slug, so the same comparison cannot drift apart between its /answers/ and /comparisons/ copies. scripts/install_comparison_tables.js stamps them in; scripts/validators/validate_comparison_tables.js fails if a published comparison page has no table. The sixth, grazing-table-vs-charcuterie-board, keeps its table in data/queries/query_universe.json (costTable), which the page generator renders directly; the installer leaves any page that already has a table alone.
_rules: Every cell non-empty (validate:no-empty-cells). No prices: they live in data/offers/services.json and data/rentals/games.json, and a number copied here would drift. No reviews, ratings, counts or "insured" claims - none exist on record.
